disposable_postgres.fixture_scope: Minimal synthetic schema matching the relations and columns read or replaced by migration 397; this did not replay migrations 001-396.
checks: Migration 397 applied in one transaction with no duplicate location-level rows.
Plot-specific WorldClim rows take precedence over location-level baselines.
A plot without a specific row receives the location-level fallback; two plots still produce exactly two feature rows.
The partial unique index rejects a second location-level row while allowing plot-specific rows.
Duplicate legacy location-level rows make the migration fail transactionally; both rows remain and the index/view are absent after rollback.

limitations: The disposable PostgreSQL fixture proves migration syntax, index behavior, view fallback, and duplicate-preflight rollback against the referenced schema shape; it does not replay the full 001-396 bootstrap or inspect candidate WorldClim rows.
Migration 397 fails transactionally if duplicate location-level baselines exist and does not delete or select among them; any such rows need reviewed reconciliation before rollout.
The WorldClim compatibility command computes latitude_proxy_v1 estimates and does not fetch WorldClim rasters. Google Earth Engine provider output and duplicate replay behavior were not exercised.
No Raspberry Pi hardware was available or used; physical-device behavior remains unverified.
